id: \bA new battle. Let's go.
en: \bA new battle. Let's go.
it: \bUna nuova lotta. Andiamo.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 602.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 602.
it: Smart Rotom: In base alle prestazioni, la tua posizione in classifica ora è 602.

id: Announcment. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Ariel, located in Floaroma Town, is ready for battle.
en: Announcment. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Ariel, located in Floaroma Town, is ready for battle.
it: Annuncio. Trovato un nuovo avversario per le World Coronation Series. Ariel, che si trova a Floraria, è pronta a lottare.

id: \bHow sad.
en: \bHow sad.
it: \bChe tristezza.

id: \rI like to stand out here and wait for the stars. You can look at this until they come.
en: \rI like to stand out here and wait for the stars. You can look at this until they come.
it: \rMi piace stare qui fuori ad aspettare le stelle. Puoi guardare questo finché non arrivano.

id: \rThis is the perfect spot to watch for stars. Don't try and get me to move.
en: \rThis is the perfect spot to watch for stars. Don't try and get me to move.
it: \rQuesto è il posto perfetto per guardare le stelle. Non provare a farmi spostare.

id: \bHala: Congratulations on beating the totem. Having beat a trial, you now get the right to fight me in a grand trial. I hope you're ready.
en: \bHala: Congratulations on beating the totem. Having beat a trial, you now get the right to fight me in a grand trial. I hope you're ready.
it: \bHala: Congratulazioni per aver sconfitto il Pokémon dominante. Avendo superato una prova, ora hai il diritto di sfidarmi nella gran prova. Spero tu sia pronto.

id: \bWonderful job. Take this as a reward. A Fighti-
en: \bWonderful job. Take this as a reward. A Fighti-
it: \bOttimo lavoro. Prendi questo come ricompensa. Un Lottiu-

id: \bAh, it seems Tapu Koko has a different opinion. Take this one instead.
en: \bAh, it seems Tapu Koko has a different opinion.  Take this one instead.
it: \bAh, pare che Tapu Koko la pensi diversamente.  Prendi questo, invece.

id: \bAn Electrium Z. With that you can power up your Electric-type attacks.
en: \bAn Electrium Z. With that you can power up your Electric-type attacks.
it: \bUn Electrium Z. Con questo puoi potenziare i tuoi attacchi di tipo Elettro.

id: Rotom Dex: Let's go back and inform the professor of your win.
en: Rotom Dex: Let's go back and inform the professor of your win.
it: Rotom Dex: Torniamo a informare il professore della tua vittoria.

id: \bHala: I would suggest Olivia next. Akala would be a fun place to try next.
en: \bHala: I would suggest Olivia next. Akala would be a fun place to try next.
it: \bHala: Ti consiglierei Olivia come prossima. Akala sarebbe un bel posto da provare dopo.

id: \bSableye
en: \bSableye
it: \bSableye

id: \bHala is the Kahuna of this island. You can only challenge him after beating one trial on the island.
en: \bHala is the Kahuna of this island. You can only challenge him after beating one trial on the island.
it: \bHala è il Kahuna di quest'isola. Puoi sfidarlo solo dopo aver superato una prova sull'isola.

id: Iki Town\nThe place where we give thanks to Pokémon.
en: Iki Town\nThe place where we give thanks to Pokémon.
it: Lili\nIl luogo in cui ringraziamo i Pokémon.

id: \rFlabébé
en: \rFlabébé
it: \rFlabébé

id: \bI'm in the mood to share the move Drain Punch with you.
en: \bI'm in the mood to share the move Drain Punch with you.
it: \bMi va di condividere con te la mossa Assorbipugno.

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \bCome back anytime!
en: \bCome back anytime!
it: \bTorna quando vuoi!

id: \bSo you want to know about Pokémon that used to evolve by trade? Let me break it down for you. Which do you want to know about?
en: \bSo you want to know about Pokémon that used to evolve by trade? Let me break it down for you.  Which do you want to know about?
it: \bQuindi vuoi sapere dei Pokémon che un tempo si evolvevano tramite scambio? Te lo spiego io. Di quale vuoi sapere?

id: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, Haunter, Boldore, Gurdurr, Phantump, Pumpkaboo, and Alolan Graveler evolve at level 35.
en: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, Haunter, Boldore, Gurdurr, Phantump, Pumpkaboo, and Alolan Graveler evolve at level 35.
it: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, Haunter, Boldore, Gurdurr, Phantump, Pumpkaboo e Graveler di Alola si evolvono al livello 35.

id: \bPoliwhirl and Slowpoke evolve in the day when holding a King's Rock. Onix at day with a Metal Coat. Porygon at day with an Upgrade.
en: \bPoliwhirl and Slowpoke evolve in the day when holding a King's Rock. Onix at day with a Metal Coat.  Porygon at day with an Upgrade.
it: \bPoliwhirl e Slowpoke si evolvono di giorno se tengono una Roccia di Re. Onix di giorno con una Metalcoperta. Porygon di giorno con un Upgrade.

id: \bClamperl at day with a Deep Sea Scale. Feebas at day with a Prism Scale.
en: \bClamperl at day with a Deep Sea Scale. Feebas at day with a Prism Scale.
it: \bClamperl di giorno con una Squamabissi. Feebas di giorno con una Squama Bella.

id: \bRhydon at day with a Protector. Magmar at day with a Magmarizer. Spritzee at day with a Sachet.
en: \bRhydon at day with a Protector. Magmar at day with a Magmarizer. Spritzee at day with a Sachet.
it: \bRhydon di giorno con un Copertura. Magmar di giorno con un Magmatore. Spritzee di giorno con una Bustina Aromi.

id: \bScyther evolves when holding a Metal Coat at night. Seadra at night with a Dragon Scale. Porygon2 at night with a Dubious Disk.
en: \bScyther evolves when holding a Metal Coat at night. Seadra at night with a Dragon Scale. Porygon2 at night with a Dubious Disk.
it: \bScyther si evolve di notte se tiene una Metalcoperta. Seadra di notte con una Squama Drago. Porygon2 di notte con un Dubbiodisco.

id: \bClamperl at night with a Deep Sea Tooth.
en: \bClamperl at night with a Deep Sea Tooth.
it: \bClamperl di notte con un Dente Abissi.

id: \bElectabuzz at night with an Electirizer. Dusclops at night with a Reaper Cloth. Swirlix at night with a Whipped Dream.
en: \bElectabuzz at night with an Electirizer. Dusclops at night with a Reaper Cloth. Swirlix at night with a Whipped Dream.
it: \bElectabuzz di notte con un Elettritore. Dusclops di notte con un Terrorpanno. Swirlix di notte con una Dolcespuma.

id: \bKarrablast evolves when Shelmet or Accelgor are in your party. Shelmet evolves when Karrablast or Escavalier are in your party.
en: \bKarrablast evolves when Shelmet or Accelgor are in your party. Shelmet evolves when Karrablast or Escavalier are in your party.
it: \bKarrablast si evolve quando Shelmet o Accelgor sono nella tua squadra. Shelmet si evolve quando Karrablast o Escavalier sono nella tua squadra.

id: \bCome back again if you want to know more.
en: \bCome back again if you want to know more.
it: \bTorna pure se vuoi saperne di più.
